description: An ACTION_REQUIRED check whose run GitHub reports as held on the `production` environment (pending_deployments lists required reviewers and viewer capability). A rerun cannot satisfy the gate, so iterate escalates with check-follow-up-unavailable, and the evidence names the environment and its reviewers. Compare 70-escalate-check-follow-up-action-required, where the run has no pending deployment (the fork 'approve and run' gate).
